This PR continues the ongoing effort to enforce IWYU warnings.

See [Developer Notes](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/developer-notes.md#using-iwyu).

Based on https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36805 and https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36807.

refactor: Introduce `node/node_id.h` header

Two identical declarations of `NodeId` make it ambiguous for static
tools such as IWYU which header should provide the symbol. Move the
declaration into a header of its own.

`net.h` re-exports it, since `NodeId` is part of its interface.
